Live arXiv exact-conjunction searches for vanishing+census (0 hits), n=12 (0 hits), constants 945 (0 hits) and 30336 (0 hits) returned no covering work; title search (64 hits) and Dilated (2 hits)/Durfee (1 hit) hits are the asymptotic/bound/ray/classifier papers inspected above. Claim-level comparison on hypotheses (fixed n=12, p(12)=77, lex-descending index, MN class-sum g=N/12!), quantifiers (all 79079 orbits with integrality/nonnegativity), parameter ranges (Durfee max 3, dominance counts, (1,1,3) 780/780 pocket), exact constants (945 unique, next values 716/697/550/533, max dim 7700, sum d^2=12!), proof scope (stdlib MN plus dual-build/orthogonality/hook/dim-sum checks plus replay.py --full) and conclusion (ground-truth certificate, explicitly no new formula/bound, no hardness/Saxl resolution) shows no prior states or implies these numbers. value.rationale: Independently worth finding later as falsifiable ground truth where theory is silent: NP-hardness says no simple polyhedral vanishing criterion exists, Pak-Panova-type bounds are shown here to be far from tight at the maximum (trivial dim bound 7700 vs actual 945, ~12%), and ML predictors give only heuristic accuracy, so an exhaustive exact table matters. Content exceeds raw enumeration: (i) extremal witness M(12)=945 uniquely at the self-conjugate max-dim Durfee-3 shape (5,3,2,1,1)^3 with 77-term exact certificate recomputable from the triple alone; (ii) vanishing fraction 38.3616% unordered (38.6662% ordered) with full Durfee-profile breakdown showing high-Durfee blocks nearly always nonzero (2,3,3:4.4%, 3,3,3:4.1%) vs hook-heavy blocks mostly vanishing, including a clean 780/780 100%-vanishing (1,1,3) pocket; (iii) dominance analysis reversing the naive heuristic (more comparable => more likely to vanish: 9.9%/19.0%/35.5%/41.3% for 0/1/2/3 comparable pairs) with 22367 fully-comparable zeros and 390 incomparable nonzeros. Choice of n=12 is motivated (first p(n)=77>70, no staircase anchor, rectangular/self-conjugate/Durfee-3 interaction), not mere n=11->12 substitution. Not a textbook restatement (no textbook gives this census), not a tiny gain, and not an unexplained dump (certificates + bound-tightness test + predictor confusion). Single-n computational scope is honestly limited and does not resolve hardness/Saxl/GCT, but supplies data those theories must fit; any future combinatorial formula must reproduce M(12) and the vanishing pattern.
